bg_status.description: List, tail, or stop background tasks spawned by bg_task or /bg. Use pid for log/stop.
bg_status.label: Background Process Status

action.description: list=show tracked tasks, log=view task output by pid, stop=terminate by pid

pid.description: Task pid for action=log or action=stop

bg_task.description: Spawn, inspect, and stop explicit background shell tasks without blocking the current turn. Tasks write persistent logs, do not time out by default, stop as a process group on Unix, and can wake the agent on exit or matching output. The background-tasks extension also auto-diverts recognized bash monitoring loops before they block.
bg_task.promptSnippet: Spawn, inspect, and stop explicit non-blocking background shell tasks.
promptGuidelines: Use bg_task instead of bash backgrounding/nohup when the user wants a long-running command to continue while the conversation remains usable.
Use bg_task list/log/stop to inspect or terminate tasks started by bg_task or /bg.
Use bg_task for pi-bridge, session, tmux, agent/delegate, or log monitoring instead of raw foreground bash polling loops.
If a bash monitor is auto-backgrounded, continue the turn and inspect it later with bg_task log/list/stop rather than waiting on foreground bash.
bg_task.label: Background Task

action.description: spawn=start a task, list=show tasks, log=view output, stop=terminate, clear=remove finished tasks

id.description: Task id for action=log or action=stop

notifyOnExit.description: Wake the agent when the task exits. Defaults to true.

notifyOnOutput.description: Wake the agent when new output arrives. Defaults to false.

notifyPattern.description: Substring or /regex/flags gate for output wakeups.

notifyMode.description: Output wake mode: always=every output update, transition=only changed output tail hash, first-match-only=one notifyPattern match then suppress output wakes. Default: first-match-only when notifyPattern is set, transition otherwise (set 'always' explicitly to opt into every-output wakes).

dedupeKey.description: Optional key used by notifyMode=transition to coalesce matching output wakes across tasks.

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for spawned tasks. Defaults to 0 (disabled).
